scope: Version the existing source-bound call-row task to give all five roles trusted review metadata, preserve the bounded final proposal, and bind Auditor attribution to its original immutable receipt without changing historical requests or authority.
riskAnalysis: Review/source provenance and exact policy selection are security sensitive. New v3 objective/policy only; v1/v2 descriptors, requests, consumed approvals and receipts stay exact. Keep source grammar, no tools, no generated execution/publication/acceptance, counting/token/wire bounds, serial grants and revocation unchanged. Prose checks detect syntax limits, not semantic quality.

threatModel.assets: Immutable source/task/release identity, prior model receipts, QA/Auditor criticism, authority and usage accounting.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Server-owned task contract and ledger-bound Specialist/Auditor identities versus untrusted model prose; technical review versus human acceptance; wire sizing versus authenticated token counting.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged reviewer reference, reviewer-stage identity substituted for Specialist binding, cross-workspace prior receipts, acceptance after Auditor rejection, stale-policy use, instruction injection and clipped prose pretending to be complete evidence.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact v3 policy/controller/UI selection; receipt-derived Specialist attribution; schema/backend equality for original Auditor receipt/decision/reason digest; unchanged QA/rejection/source validation; field-aware diagnostics and full bounded proposal; no model tools, retries, code execution or publication.

defects.rootCause: Saved successful v2 requests supplied replacement grammar only to Specialist. Other roles lacked that contract, final input omitted the full proposal, and several permitted narrative fields ended mid-sentence; final claimed verbatim preservation was incomplete.
defects.detectionGap: Prior fixtures verified five-stage coordination and exact criticism rows but did not require every reviewer to see the same contract or characterize actual clipped prose.
defects.regression: Freeze all ten v2 request bodies before edits; retain original v1 golden tests. Actual five-stage owner controller/CAS fixture verifies all-role contract, Specialist identity, full final proposal, exact Auditor reference, 12000x5 counting and cleanup; reject clipped QA with usage retained, forged provenance/reference and false acceptance. Stress bounded final wire separately from provider token measurement.
defects.historicalPrevention: Version model-visible contracts, test each role context against the same trusted source, distinguish source attribution from prose claims, preserve full immutable reviews, and state syntactic/fixture limits honestly.

rollback: Disable paid execution and future flags; revoke fresh grants and stop the sequence. Keep historical v1/v2/v3 descriptors, policies and receipts readable. Revert behavior only through a reviewed feature successor, never erase records or revive approvals.
